p: Enhance your natural beauty with Derma Radiant Lip Tint, a nourishing lip care essential designed to gently exfoliate and brighten your lips while adding a soft, natural tint. This lightweight formula helps remove dry, flaky skin, revealing smoother and healthier-looking lips.

Crafted for gentle exfoliation and lip lightening, it works to improve lip texture and restore a fresh, even tone. The smooth, balm-like consistency glides effortlessly, delivering hydration along with a subtle hint of color for a naturally radiant finish.
Ideal for everyday wear, Derma Radiant Lip Tint keeps your lips soft, supple, and beautifully tinted with every application.
li: Helps lighten and even out lip tone
Compact 5g jar – perfect for daily use
